title: Squash and Butternut Fritters with Wholesome Aioli
description: Crunchy fritters filled with roasted squash and butternut, served with a creamy wholesome aioli for dipping. A delicious Italian-inspired side dish.
instructions: Toss diced butternut squash with 1 tablespoon olive oil and roast for 25-30 minutes, or until tender.
In a large bowl, combine grated butternut squash, thai flour, ji jeen parsley, and wholesome aioli.
Stir in 1 egg and 1/4 cup grated wholesome.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Heat 1/2 inch vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the patties to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve hot with wholesome aioli for dipping.
To make wholesome aioli, mix 1/4 cup wholesome with 1 egg yolk and 1 tablespoon lemon juice in a bowl.
Slowly drizzle in 1/2 cup olive oil, whisking constantly until smooth and creamy.
